messages.content: Predict a real Russian-speaking Toloka respondent's recorded decision or belief report. This is an individual give-or-take Dictator Game. You are Participant A, the allocator, matched with another Participant B, who has no money-allocation decision. Initially you have 100 US cents (a basic 50 plus an additional 50), and B has 50 cents. A signed transfer t must be one of -50,-40,-30,-20,-10,0,10,20,30,40,50 US cents. Positive t gives money to B, negative t takes money from B, and zero leaves both endowments unchanged. The resulting game bonuses are 100-t cents for you and 50+t cents for B; the separate one-dollar participation payment is not part of these endowments. Actual choices affect bonuses. The polarizing statement is: 'LGBT people should have the same rights to marry as people of heterosexual orientation.' Own agreement was recorded before the game. Only information already available at the current stage is supplied. B cannot inspect your answers to the attitude questions. No other participants' choices or final population frequencies are shown. Predict the recorded response without advice or moral judgment. You are now offered a free choice to learn whether B agreed or disagreed with the statement. The actual answer is not supplied before your choice. If you choose to learn, only you will see that answer. Output exactly reveal to learn or avoid to decline.
